recognize_zh: 這是 G 顯帶核型圖（非形態圖）：第 8 號染色體有三條（箭頭指出多出的一條），性染色體為 XX，其餘染色體數目與結構看來正常，即 47,XX,+8。
features: G-banded karyogram with chromosomes arranged 1 to 22 plus sex chromosomes
Three copies of chromosome 8 with arrow pointing to the extra homolog
Two X chromosomes, no Y chromosome (female)
No obvious structural rearrangement of other chromosomes at this band resolution
describe_en: The figure is a G-banded karyogram rather than a morphologic image. It shows three copies of chromosome 8, with the extra homolog marked by an arrow, and two X chromosomes, with no apparent structural abnormality at this banding resolution. The karyotype reads 47,XX,+8. Trisomy 8 is a recurrent abnormality in myeloid neoplasms and is one of the most frequent acquired cytogenetic changes in patients with germline GATA2 mutation, along with monosomy 7.
